## Reviewer brief

- Result: `dbNodeToCrossApp` and its bulk form `dbNodesToCrossApp` convert database rows to `CrossAppNode`, next to the schema and relation converters in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`. As the [2026-10-25 Decision](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985#comment-b51510b9) asks, the row logic moves out of `buildSharedNodes` instead of being written again, so discovery and the converter share it. Discovery still returns `SharedNode`; ENG-2091 switches it to the converter.
- Size: 477 changed lines excluding tests, about 130 of them moved from `sharedNodes.ts`. The Decision puts the refactor and the converter in one PR, and splitting them would mean writing the row logic twice.
- Review entry points: `resolveDbNode`, `dbNodeToCrossApp` and `dbNodesToCrossApp` in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`, then `buildSharedNodes` in `sharedNodes.ts`. The moved code maps like this:

  | `sharedNodes.ts` on main | This PR, `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts` | Change |
  |---|---|---|
  | `SharedConcept`, `SharedContent`, `SharedContentSummary` | `DbNodeConcept`, `DbNodeContent`, `DbNodeContentSummary` | Renamed. `concepts_of_relation` takes its element type from `my_concepts`, so the null checks on it are gone. |
  | `normalizeUtcTimestamp`, `getLatestTimestamp` | Same names | None |
  | `getResourceKey({ sourceLocalId, spaceId })` | `getResourceKey(row)` | Takes the row. Same keys. |
  | Content grouping in `buildSharedNodes` | `groupDbNodeRows` | None |
  | Per-node checks and slot resolution in `buildSharedNodes` | `resolveDbNode` | Each check throws. Discovery catches and skips the node. Two edge cases change, listed below. |

- Incomplete rows: the bulk converter skips a node it can't represent and logs a warning. That covers a node with no author or a node type the reader can't see. Nothing calls the converter in production until ENG-2091.
- Core title: a node with no stored core title gets one derived from its node type's format (`resolveSchemaFormat`, then `extractContentFromTitle`). Only those nodes trigger the format lookup.
- Unset fields: `content.full`, `content.directAndDescription` and `assets` stay unset. Discovery doesn't read that content, and #1577 decided the description isn't read back from the database.
- Discovery output changes in two edge cases, because it now shares the converter's row logic:
  - A node whose slot target is in a space with an unparseable URL is skipped. Before, it failed the whole listing.
  - A same-space slot target with no local id is left out. Before, it came back as `null`.
- `crossAppContracts.ts` now imports `ContentType` from `@repo/content-model/constants`. Without it, Obsidian's type check fails (TS2354) once `sharedNodes.ts` imports the converters.

## Verification

- `pnpm ci:validate` passes on `56bffbbd`.
- New tests in `dbToCrossAppConverters.test.ts` cover author and node type as local ids, slot targets as a local id in the same space and as a rid in another space, `modifiedAt` from whichever of the Concept, direct Content and full Content changed last, the derived core title, and skipping a node the contract can't represent.
- The discovery tests in `sharedNodes.test.ts` pass unchanged.
- Not run against a live database. ENG-1879, later in this stack, adds a database round trip through discovery.

## Loom video

Not recorded, on purpose. This PR has no user-visible change. Nothing calls the converter in production until ENG-2091, and discovery's output only changes in the two edge cases above. The ENG-2091 PR shows the converter's first visible effect.

## Scope check

- [x] Ran `$scope-check` against ENG-1985 and the final diff.
- Scope beyond `Done When`: A node with no stored core title gets one derived from its node type's format instead of being skipped, which adds a format lookup for those nodes. Discovery also changes in the two slot edge cases above.
- Required now: `CrossAppNode` requires `coreTitle`, and discovery lists nodes without a stored core title today, so skipping them would drop them from ENG-2091's listing. The edge cases come from sharing the row logic, which the Decision requires, and `CrossAppNode` slots can't hold `null`.
- Anyone affected or consulted: Not documented. Both were decided while implementing on 2026-10-25.
- Decision: The refactor and the skip-and-log rule are in the [2026-10-25 Decision](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985#comment-b51510b9). The derived core title and the edge cases are in the [2026-11-05 Decision](DECISION_LINK).

## Standards check

- [x] Ran `$dg-pr-adherence-check` against the final diff and PR metadata.

## Local delegated full review

- [x] Ran a comprehensive review of the entire final diff in a subagent with a fresh context. Use `$dg-delegated-full-review` when no other full-review workflow is available.
